title: Anuonyam a Ɛmemee
intro: Fa w’adwene bu eyi: ɔkra bi a ɔhyɛ ntade pa na ademude a wontumi nsusuw ho atwa ne ho ahyia. Ná saa onipa yi gye di sɛ wɔn ankasa nyansa na wonya wɔn ahonyade, na wannye nokware nsiesiei fibea antom da. Bere a ɔnam odiyifo tumidifo bi akyidifo mu no, saa onipa yi pow ɔfrɛ biara a ɔde bɛkɔ ahobrɛase mu. Ɛnnɛ, yehu onipa bi a n’ahonyade a ɛyɛ nwonwa no bɛyɛɛ wɔn homebea a etwa to no.
clues: Metenaa ase wɔ odiyifo bi a ɔfrɛɛ ɔman a wɔn tirim yɛ den baa nokware mu no bere so.
Ná meka mpɔtam bi a wɔapaw wɔn ho, nanso me koma dan fii nkrasɛm no ho.
Sika ne dwetɛ gyee me dommum sen ɔsoro ahyɛde biara.
M’akorade akorae no yɛɛ kɛse araa ma ɛkame ayɛ sɛ mmarima kuw bi a wɔyɛ den ntumi mma nsafe no so.
Mehoahoaa me ho sɛ m’ahonyade na wɔde maa me esiane m’ankasa nimdeɛ nti.
Awiei koraa no, asase no menee me ne me tenabea nyinaa sɛ kɔkɔbɔ.

arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فِى زِينَتِهِۦ ۖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا يَـٰلَيْتَ لَنَا مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ قَـٰرُونُ إِنَّهُۥ لَذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍۢ
verse: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qārūn. Indeed, he is one of great fortune." (28:79)
